description: TXN-RANGE across processes, with a final read after the pause (the earlier xproc far-row probe showed no independent read of b's surviving change). Process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; b updates V of row 64 (far), row 2 (same page) and U row 1 (Errors before/after); a Rollback (phase 1) or CommitTrans (phase 2); b pauses 7 s, Idle and reads rows 1, 2, 64 and U row 1; a finally reads. Asks whether b's admitted unrelated change survives a's rollback and commit, and that the refused one stays refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
